name: dotnet-msix

Package .NET desktop apps as MSIX: create from WinUI 3 `.csproj` or WPF/WinForms WAP `.wapproj`; sign for development, production, or Store; distribute via Store, App Installer, or enterprise deployment; configure auto-updates, bundles, and CI/CD.

Assumptions: Windows App SDK 1.6+, .NET 8.0+, Windows 10 build 19041+ (MSIX); build 1709+ (App Installer auto-update). See [skill:dotnet-winui], [skill:dotnet-native-aot], [skill:dotnet-gha-patterns], [skill:dotnet-ado-patterns], [skill:dotnet-nuget-authoring], [skill:dotnet-containers], and [references/detailed-examples.md](references/detailed-examples.md).

WinUI 3 can package directly from `.csproj` using `<WindowsPackageType>MSIX</WindowsPackageType>`. WPF/WinForms use a Visual Studio Windows Application Packaging Project; include `<ProjectReference Include="..\MyWpfApp\MyWpfApp.csproj" />`.

Build:
dotnet publish --configuration Release --runtime win-x64 \

All MSIX packages must be signed to install on Windows. The signing certificate's Subject must match the `Publisher` attribute in the package manifest.

Development signing:
$cert = New-SelfSignedCertificate `
-Subject "CN=My Company, O=My Company, L=Seattle, S=WA, C=US" `
-FriendlyName "MyApp Dev Signing" `
-CertStoreLocation "Cert:\CurrentUser\My" `
-TextExtension @("<REDACTED_IP>={text}<REDACTED_IP>.<REDACTED_IP>.3", `
"<REDACTED_IP>={text}")
$password = ConvertTo-SecureString -String "$env:CERT_PASSWORD" -Force -AsPlainText
Export-PfxCertificate -Cert $cert `
-FilePath "MyApp_DevSigning.pfx" `
$signtool = Get-ChildItem "C:\Program Files (x86)\Windows Kits\10\bin\*\x64\signtool.exe" |
Sort-Object { [version]($_.Directory.Parent.Name) } -Descending |
Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName
& $signtool sign /fd SHA256 /a /f "MyApp_DevSigning.pfx" `
/p "$env:CERT_PASSWORD" `
"AppPackages\MyApp_1.0.0.0_x64.msix"

Production direct-download signing uses a trusted CA, matching `Package.appxmanifest` Publisher, and timestamp:
& signtool.exe sign /fd SHA256 /sha1 "THUMBPRINT_HERE" `
/tr http://timestamp.digicert.com /td SHA256 `
"AppPackages\MyApp_1.0.0.0_x64.msix"
& signtool.exe sign /fd SHA256 /f "production-cert.pfx" `
/p "$env:CERT_PASSWORD" `
/tr http://timestamp.digicert.
